jobs.title: Executive Director, Data Management
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


We are an organization comprised of industry thought leaders who are passionate about health data and want to make a difference in the health care field. We are an independent, not\-for\-profit organization and together with our partners we provide essential information on Canada's health systems, enabling decisions that lead to healthier Canadians. As a valued member of the CIHI team, you and your work will have a pivotal role in the evolution of Canada's health care systems.


CIHI is recognized as an exceptional place to work that embraces diversity, respect, integrity, collaboration and innovation. Learn about our Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and the work being done to create a more inclusive and welcoming organization by focusing on how we learn, govern and practise.


At CIHI, we recognize what matters to our employees. Some of the benefits of working at CIHI include

* HOOPP Pension Plan (Defined Benefits Pension)
* Retirement Planning Program
* Generous vacation days for permanent and long\-term contracts
* Work\-life balance
* Career Planning Program
* Learning and Professional Development Program
* Flexible benefits program from your first day on the job for permanent and long\-term contracts

**Why is this role important?**


Reporting to the Vice President \& Chief Operations Officer, Business Operations Division, the Executive Director provides enterprise leadership and sets strategic direction for the management and advancement of CIHI’s data assets, ensuring data is acquired, integrated, managed and made available effectively to support products, analytics and strategic priorities and the data and information needs of governments, health systems and other stakeholders. The Executive Director leads the evolution of the data lifecycle, driving greater integration, modernization and efficiency in how data moves through CIHI while strengthening the quality, timeliness and usability of CIHI’s data holdings through emerging technologies and AI.  

  

The portfolio is focused on accessing the right data for CIHI, managing it effectively and enabling its use. It inherently has strong interdependencies with Standards, Governance \& Stewardship and Analytics, while maintaining primary accountability for the management and operational enablement of the data itself.

**What you'll do**


1\. Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Data Management portfolio, aligned with CIHI’s mandate, strategic priorities and evolving data needs.
  

2\. Lead the development and execution of portfolio priorities, plans and initiatives to strengthen the management, integration, quality and accessibility of CIHI’s data assets.
  

3\. Oversee the effective allocation of financial, human and technical resources, ensuring sustainable delivery and value for investment.
  

4\. Drive integration and collaboration across portfolios and functions, identifying and removing organizational, operational and other barriers that inhibit progress and the advancement of enterprise priorities.
  

5\. Strengthen integration across related data, analytics, technology and corporate functions and identify opportunities to improve how work is coordinated across the organization.
  

6\. Provide executive advice on emerging opportunities, risks, priorities and decisions affecting CIHI’s data capabilities and longer\-term direction.
  

7\. Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to advance shared objectives and support the effective use and evolution of CIHI’s data assets.
  

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.
  

9\. Champion change and modernization within the portfolio, challenging established approaches where appropriate and creating the conditions for timely decision\-making, execution and progress.

**What you'll bring to the table**

* Degree in a relevant discipline, including business, health, information management, data, analytics, technology or a related field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.
* Minimum 10\-12 years of progressive experience leading complex, enterprise\-wide portfolios, initiatives and organizational change in a leadership capacity with a focus on data management, information management, analytics, technology or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of data management practices, data lifecycle principles and the evolving role of data in supporting organizational and health\-system priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy, translate priorities into action and deliver results in complex and evolving environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries, navigate competing priorities and dependencies, and identify and remove barriers that impede execution or organizational progress.
* Strong relationship\-building, consultation, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment among senior leaders and diverse internal and external partners.
* Demonstrated judgment and decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities, risks, resources and operational considerations.
* Ability to fulfill travel requirements.
* Fluency in English is required, bilingualism in both official languages is an asset.

  

There are three Executive Director opportunities available through this competitive process. If you have applied to more than one of these opportunities, please identify your preferred position(s) of interest in your cover letter.**Closing Statement**

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Analytics & AI
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

Enterprise Analytics is a high\-impact team that helps shape business strategy through data, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI). As a Director, Data Science, you'll build strong relationships with stakeholders, understand strategic priorities, and recommend sophisticated models and AI solutions that support business goals, with a focus on Wealth and Fraud. You'll lead, manage, and mentor a team of junior and senior data scientists while taking a hands\-on approach to solving complex problems. In this senior leadership role, you'll help plan and manage change across client\-facing analytics and AI initiatives, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business needs. You'll also act as a trusted partner to leaders across the bank, helping connect analytical insights to meaningful business outcomes.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

* **Business partnership \-** Build strong relationships with business leaders across CIBC to understand priorities, identify opportunities, and apply advanced analytics to solve complex business problems.
* **Analytics leadership \-** Lead and deliver key analytical initiatives across multiple lines of business, ensuring work is aligned to strategic goals and delivers measurable value.
* **Model development and oversight \-** Oversee the design, validation, implementation, and evaluation of statistical and machine learning models that address complex business challenges and large data sets.
* **Insight generation \-** Work closely with subject matter experts to understand business context, assess data sources, guide data transformation activities, and develop features that improve model performance.
* **Execution and sustainment \-** See analytics work through to completion by supporting deployment, handoff, and ongoing model refreshes or enhancements as business needs evolve.
* **Team and storytelling leadership \-** Mentor data scientists on modelling, coding, and best practices, while helping teams translate analytical findings into clear, compelling business stories and executive presentations.
  

**Who you are**

* **You can demonstrate experience** in decision science, data science, advanced modelling, and analytical techniques. It's an asset if you bring experience supporting Wealth, Fraud, or other complex financial services use cases.
* **You have strong technical expertise** . You bring extensive hands\-on experience with modern data science and machine learning tools including Python, pandas, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and SQL. You also have strong coding skills, knowledge of DevOps tools, and experience with one or more cloud platforms.
* **You have a graduate degree in** mathematics, computer science, electrical and computer engineering, or a related quantitative field. A master's degree or doctorate is strongly preferred.
* **You are a caring and accountable leader** . You have experience developing and implementing strategic team goals. You have experience coaching employees and inspiring successful team performance.
* **You're digitally savvy.** You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools and trends.
* **You're motivated by collective success** . You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
* **Values matter to you.** You bring your real self to work, and you live our values \- trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program\*, defined benefit pension plan\*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

* Subject to plan and program terms and conditions


**What you need to know**

* CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers\-carrieres@cibc.com
* CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
* You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
* We may ask you to complete an attribute\-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).

jobs.description:
As Director, Strategy \& Transformation, you will partner closely with Procurement and Administrative Services leadership to shape and execute strategic priorities that drive meaningful business outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to lead high\-impact initiatives across AI enablement, business transformation, stakeholder experience, value measurement, and operating model modernization. By translating complex challenges into actionable strategies and measurable results, you will help strengthen our ability to deliver efficient, innovative, and customer\-focused services. In this highly visible role, you'll work directly with senior leaders and gain the opportunity to influence enterprise\-wide decisions, transformation programs, and future ways of working.  



**Position Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

* Lead the development and execution of strategic initiatives across Procurement and Administrative Services, translating leadership priorities into actionable transformation plans and measurable outcomes.
* Support AI strategy development, adoption planning, value realization frameworks, and assessment of emerging technologies to improve business performance and service delivery.
* Design and evolve value measurement frameworks, executive scorecards, performance metrics, and reporting mechanisms that demonstrate organizational impact and support decision\-making.
* Drive digital transformation, process optimization, operating model design, and automation initiatives while coordinating cross\-functional stakeholders, risks, dependencies, and implementation activities.
* Prepare executive presentations, business cases, strategic recommendations, and leadership communications while supporting senior leadership planning, governance, and special projects.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in strategy, consulting, business transformation, operations, finance, technology, procurement, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex cross\-functional strategic, operational, or transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.
* Strong financial analysis, business case development, performance measurement, and executive communication capabilities.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Strategy, Technology, Operations, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, enterprise transformation, or Chief of Staff environments.
* Advanced degree (MBA, Master's, or equivalent) in Business, Strategy, Finance, Technology, or a related field.
* Experience developing AI strategies, digital transformation programs, automation initiatives, or innovation roadmaps.
* Experience designing operating models, governance frameworks, service delivery models, or organizational effectiveness initiatives.
* Experience working with executive leadership teams in large, complex, or regulated organizations.

**When you join our team:**
---------------------------

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

**Job Description**

**What is the Opportunity?**


You will be responsible for the development and implementation of Fraud Management strategies for RBC Bank, across all products and channels. You will achieve this objective by monitoring the current landscape, collaborating within Fraud Management and externally with Lines of Business partners. You will look to achieve a balance between fraud loss, client experience, operational cost and risk appetite. Further, you will support large transformational initiatives through thought leadership, risk identification and collaboration with internal stakeholders.

 **What will you do?**

* Be the trusted advisor to business partners and assess current and emerging fraud risks to develop and implement strategic plans that support business transformation.
* Offer subject matter expertise on large scale transformation initiatives to ensure the right controls are implemented both within RBC Bank and the industry to create a seamless client experience balanced against fraud risk.
* Provide Senior Management and Business partners with timely updates on fraud loss savings, performance against risk appetite and any ongoing risks.
* Conduct data analysis to support business case development for technology or FTE investment.
* Work collaboratively to identify and execute against opportunities to optimize the balance across the risk pillars, while managing a prioritized backlog of ideas.
* Stay apprised of production and operations strategies and objectives, and conduct research to assess best in class fraud mitigation strategies and technologies.
* In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide

 **What must you have to succeed?**

**Must\-haves:**

* 3\+ years’ experience in a risk management, product or channel role
* Excellent communication skills, experience presenting to executive audiences
* Financial services industry experience with banking product knowledge
* Ability to work on problems of complex and diverse scope, and identify creative alternatives
* Strong analytical skills and critical thinking with a proven ability to source, analyze and summarize transactional and financial data
* Demonstrated skill in developing processes, using creative analytical, problem solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint and highly organized with ability to multitask and shift priorities.
* Professional written and oral communication skills
* In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

 **Nice\-to\-have**

* Project Management or Consulting experience

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. * A comprehensive Total Rewards Program

* Leaders who support your development
